result.brief: 提出用LLM合成控制器结构、无导数搜索拟合参数的实时控制方法，与视频世界模型、视频生成及音视频生成方向无直接关联。
result.reason: Synthesizes LLM-structured Python controllers with derivative-free parameter fitting for control; no video world model, video/audio generation, or unified multimodal evidence. World models only mentioned as prior work requiring planning.
